baseline.user_template:
Analyze this text for errors and unsupported claims.

<text>
{input}
</text>

notes: The API key is read from the environment variable named in api_key_env. Never put a key in this file.
temperature: null means the parameter is not sent. Current Claude Opus/Sonnet/Fable models reject non-default sampling parameters; set a number only for a model that accepts it.
effort is sent as output_config.effort; set it to null to omit it (for example for models without effort support).
Both methods use the same model, effort, temperature and max_tokens. Only the system prompt and user template differ.
Server-side refusal fallbacks are intentionally not enabled: a fallback would answer some cases with a different model and confound the comparison. Refusals are recorded in manifest.json instead.
